claims: The Artemis II mission splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California.
The Artemis II mission splashed down on April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II mission splashed down at 8:07 p.m. ET.
The Artemis II mission splashed down at 5:07 p.m. PT.
The Artemis II mission's Orion capsule landed roughly 50 nautical miles off the coast of San Diego, California.
The Artemis II mission's crew was recovered by the USS John P. Murtha.
The Artemis II mission duration was 10 days.
The Artemis II splashdown marked the completion of the first crewed mission to the Moon in over 50 years.
